notes: Starting cards as posted under =STARTING=: Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can, Dagobah, Prepared Defenses (dested Heading For The Medical Frigate), Wise Advice, Allegations of Corruption; these count toward the total.
Posted 'Prepared Defenses' (a Dark interrupt) on this Light list dested Heading For The Medical Frigate, the Light starting interrupt (as in earlier DeckTech rulings).

Posted 'Allegations of Corruption' is a Dark-only card (no Light printing), so it is printed as written. 'Reactor Terminal' (a Dark Premiere Effect, no Light printing; the strategy uses it to track Artoo-Detoo In Red 5) is also printed as written.

Posted 'Degobah ...' sites dested the Dagobah: sites; 'Luke's Pack' dested Luke's Backpack (the strategy calls it Luke's Backpack); 'Qui-Gon' dested Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Houjix/Out Of Somewhere' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; 'Jedi Resilience' dested A Jedi's Resilience. 'Artoo' dested the Jabba's Palace character Artoo; 'JP Audience Chamber' / 'JP Entrance Cavern' dested the Jabba's Palace: sites.
Posted 'JT 1-6' dested the six Jedi Tests: Great Warrior, A Jedi's Strength, Domain Of Evil, Size Matters Not, It Is The Future You See, You Must Confront Vader.
The byline 'Silver "Slides_Rule" Dragoon' reads as a fictional name (the Silver Dragoon of The Legend of Dragoon), so the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle Slides_Rule with no player page.
